title: Home Mortgage Loans: Late Charge Rates by State, Grace Days and Payment Options
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Late Charge Rates by State, Grace Days and Payment Options

This schedule belongs to Home Mortgage Loans and gathers the program values that bear on a borrower's monthly installment: the grace days allowed after a due date, the late charge percentage for each state the bank serves, the number of courtesy waivers a customer may receive in a rolling year, how an underpaid installment is treated, and whether automatic payment from a Piedmont Crescent Bank account can be set up.

## Values explained

- **Grace days** — calendar days following the due date before a late charge can apply.
- **Late charge percentage** — a percentage of the principal-and-interest portion of the installment, chosen by the borrower's state of residence: North Carolina (NC), South Carolina (SC) or Virginia (VA).
- **Courtesy waivers per rolling 365 days** — how many late charges may be waived as a courtesy for one customer within any rolling 365-day span.
- **Payment below one full installment** — what becomes of a remittance smaller than a full installment; the only setting used is "returned".
- **Automatic payment** — whether the borrower can pay automatically from an account held at the bank.

## Late charge percentage by state

| Program | North Carolina (%) | South Carolina (%) | Virginia (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 | 4.00 | 4.00 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 | 4.00 | 4.00 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 4.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 |

## Other payment values

| Program | Grace days | Courtesy waivers per rolling 365 days | Payment below one full installment | Automatic payment offered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 1 | returned | yes |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 1 | returned | yes |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 1 | returned | yes |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 1 | returned | yes |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 15 | 1 | returned | yes |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 | 2 | returned | yes |

## Reading the tables

**Where does the state of residence change the percentage?** Only outside North Carolina and only outside the government programs. FHA and VA loans use 4.00 percent in all three states; every other program uses 4.00 percent for North Carolina and 5.00 percent for South Carolina and Virginia.

**Which program grants more than one courtesy waiver a year?** The Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, with 2; each other program grants 1.

**Is the grace period ever longer than 15 days?** No; all six programs allow 15 calendar days.
